oneLine: Anchor Offshore Services files IPO papers

sources.title: Anchor Offshore Services files IPO papers to raise funds for working capital

synopsis: Anchor Offshore Services, a Mumbai-based engineering projects and services company promoted by Narothamdas Chanillo, has filed preliminary IPO papers with SEBI. The initial public offering comprises a fresh issue of 64 lakh shares and an offer-for-sale of 6 lakh shares by the promoters. Of the net fresh issue proceeds, Rs 82.5 crore is earmarked for long-term working capital requirements, Rs 3 crore for debt repayment, and the remainder for general corporate purposes. Nirbhay Capital Services is the merchant banker managing the issue. The company reported a net profit of Rs 8.03 crore and revenue of Rs 105.8 crore for FY26, with an order book of Rs 217.2 crore as of June 2026.
